name: snips-shell
description: The Snippet Manager's page shell: the dark top bar, the library sidebar with its language and collection lists, links under the mount prefix and the page wrapper every page plugin uses.
mount: a row `- id: snips-shell` / `name: snips-shell` after the snippets row and before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects `shell` and calls ctx.shell.nav(...) inside ctx.effect
